notes.title: "Cream of the Crop" Minor Update for the Upcoming Sequel
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2001910/Spermination_Cream_of_the_Crop/

Minor update that changes the "settings" art and main logo, adding a note about the upcoming "Cream of the Crop" sequel, linked above!

Regular price of Spermination has been [b]dropped $1[/b] to $1.99, as the sequel will take the $2.99 slot.

notes.title: ROMBIE hits BETA!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31776673/5054a656d732f55ef10cd30f5cef4465e5cf8714.png[/img]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/745090/ROMBIE/

ROMBIE is on its way to a great release, thanks to all of my private testers! Virtual Reality integration is next. Some of the latest improvements, including many visual ones:
[list]
[*]Higher resolution textures
[*]Post-processing effects
[*]More unique terrain models
[*]Customized terrain shaders
[*]Revamped decoration system
[*]New ability special effects
[/list]
An updated trailer, showing more unique gameplay features & set of screenshots are also on the to-do list for release. When will ROMBIE be released? Still looking at a month or two from now -- I want VR features, and general gameplay, to be polished on day one.

Want to help test? Head over to Facebook to apply:

http://www.phr00t.com/

tags.feature: - Higher resolution textures
- Post-processing effects
- More unique terrain models
- Customized terrain shaders
- Revamped decoration system
- New ability special effects

notes.title: OSVR Update & non-VR Fix
notes.content: Spermination is getting native OSVR integration on Windows x64! I've also fixed the non-VR option to properly not start SteamVR. If you have trouble launching Spermination in the middle of this update, try closing & reopening Steam.

notes.title: Engine & VR Update #2
notes.content: jMonkeyVR & LWJGL have been updated. SteamVR will now know the game is a "seated experience" when playing in virtual reality, so resetting your seated position should now work. I've also updated LWJGL so hopefully Linux issues have been resolved.

notes.title: Launch Update on Windows
notes.content:
Spermination will now first try using your Java installation, just in case you have a 32-bit system or a newer version of the Java runtime. If no Java version is detected, the included 64-bit Java will be used.

If the included Java version doesn't work for you, or if your Java version is outdated, install the latest here:

http://www.java.com/getjava

EDIT: Also should have fixed a Linux library loading issue.

EDIT 11/16/2015: Fixed a "GUI fragment shader" crash!

EDIT 11/17/2015: Updated jMonkeyVR, better VR & Vive support & performance!

tags.bug: EDIT: Also should have fixed a Linux library loading issue.
EDIT 11/16/2015: Fixed a "GUI fragment shader" crash!

notes.content:
Spermination now has been updated with the latest builds of jMonkeyVR & jMonkeyEngine. This includes LWJGL 3, OpenGL 3.2+ shaders & OpenVR updates.

STOP TALKING IN TONGUES WTF IS THIS!?

Better virtual reality support (HTC Vive!), better performance & compatibility.

Happy Sperminating!

notes.title: Speed & Intensity Update!
notes.content:
You've never shot your load with this much speed & intensity! Tighter controls, faster swimming, more powerups & rebalanced mechanics all included in v1.21!

You may take a little more damage, but now there are health pickups to find. Weapons use a little less energy, are a little more effective, and energy pickups will supercharge you to make more use of them!

Difficulty has been tweaked too, to. Enjoy!

Also updated Java for the Windows version.

- Difficulty has been tweaked too, to.

notes.title: v1.19 VR Update!
notes.content: Get your head into a uterus, virtually! Spermination has now been updated with OpenVR & is compatible with Oculus SDK v0.6.0.1 in Extended mode. An update will be planned for Direct Mode when the VR Compositor gets cleaned up. Using OpenVR, Spermination should be compatible with the Vive too, among other headsets. Yay!
